Police officers F.P., S.A. and R.V. stated in their report that the person ignored their lawful demand to produce his identity document.
Police officers F.P., S.A. and R.V. stated in their report that they brought the person to the police station, where they found out he was the first applicant.

Police officer T.R. stated in his report that although he invited the person to respect the discipline, the person continued his cursing and improper behaviour.
Police officer T.R. stated in his report that he brought the person to police station no. 3, where they found out the person was the second applicant.

Police officer N.M. stated in his report that the police officers approached the person and brought him to police station no. 4, where they found out the person was the third applicant.
The third applicant stated before the Sumgait City Court that he was not guilty of breaching public order by swearing at the location indicated by the police.

At the material time, Article 375.3 of the Code of Administrative Offences provided that a defender and a representative shall be allowed to participate in administrative-offence proceedings from the time an administrative-offence report is drawn up.

At the material time, Article 375.3 of the Code of Administrative Offences provided that if an individual is subjected to an administrative arrest for committing an administrative offence, a defender shall be allowed to participate in the administrative-offence proceedings from the moment of the administrative arrest.

At the material time, Article 376.2 of the Code of Administrative Offences provided that if it is impossible for the lawyer chosen by the person against whom administrative-offence proceedings are being carried out to attend, a judge shall appoint a lawyer for that person in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Azerbaijan.

At the material time, Article 376.3 of the Code of Administrative Offences provided that if a person subjected to an administrative arrest has no possibility to hire a lawyer due to his or her financial situation, his or her legal assistance shall be funded by the State, and in this case a lawyer may not refuse to carry out his or her duties.

At the material time, Article 396.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences provided that an authorised official may use administrative arrest as a measure to prevent administrative offences, to establish the identity of a person, to draw up an administrative-offence report if this cannot be done at the place of the administrative offence and if the drawing up of a report is important, to ensure the correct and timely examination of administrative-offence cases, and to ensure the implementation of decisions in administrative-offence cases.

At the material time, Article 398.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences provided that administrative arrest, that is the short-term restriction of an individual's liberty, may be applied in exceptional circumstances when deemed necessary for ensuring the correct and timely examination of an administrative-offence case or for the implementation of a decision in an administrative-offence case, except for instances set out in legislation.

The Commissioner for Human Rights of the Council of Europe criticised on various occasions the method of curbing the impact of a demonstration by allowing it to take place only at another time and at a less central location, thereby diminishing significantly the visibility of the rally and its message to the general public.

According to the report CommDH(2013)14 of 6 August 2013, the issue of limitations imposed on freedom of assembly has regularly been raised by local and international observers in recent years, with the most frequent problems including the banning of demonstrations in central and easily accessible locations and the use of force to disperse demonstrations, leading to arrests and in some cases harsh sentences.
